title: Renormalization-group locking of finite anisotropic propagation cones in Yukawa networks
summary: Different field species can begin with finite anisotropic propagation geometries whose principal axes need not coincide. We ask whether local Yukawa interactions on a finite graph can nevertheless generate one common infrared spatial cone, even when the interactions that drive the locking become marginally irrelevant. Retaining the full finite mismatch between positive-definite spatial kinetic matrices, we derive the one-loop nonlinear matrix flow and show that its Thompson diameter is globally nonexpansive.
